name: rules_v5_full_mother

remove: mostly_clouds: P(clouds level 3 or 4, i.e. more than half covered) >= 0.5
candidates_not_removed: featureless_open_sea: max(shoreline, vessels, port_structures) <= 0.3, or < 0.7 with water < 0.5, and scene is open_sea
inland: max(shoreline, vessels, port_structures) <= 0.3, or < 0.7 with water < 0.5, and scene is not open_sea
uncertain_maritime_subject: 0.3 < max(shoreline, vessels, port_structures) < 0.7 with water >= 0.5

note: remove_list.txt and candidates_*.txt only list image names; nothing in the dataset is removed or changed. Candidate lists hold kept images only.
